detail: 22 rats, one count of aberrant crypt foci each, sacrificed at three end times (endtime, a covariate); the help fits glm(count ~ endtime + I(endtime^2)) with poisson and quasipoisson families.
A summary of MASS's Cars93 ('created from information in the Cars93 data set'), one row per car class (abbrev) with its minimum and maximum passenger capacity and number of cars.
One row per ball number (1 to 39) with its frequency over 122 weekly draws; no unit repeats.
The nine largest lakes of Manitoba, one row each (elevation, area).
Australian athletes, one row each, with blood and body measures; sport and sex classify the athletes, and the page fits no model.
Annual apparent alcohol consumption (Beer, Wine, Spirit) for two countries; Country is a two-level design factor, so the table holds two short series, and the help only plots them.
15 books, one row each; the help fits lm(weight ~ volume + area).
30 patients, one binary movement outcome each; the help fits glm(nomove ~ conc, family = binomial(link = logit)).

A subset of antigua: the block means of treatment 111, the treatment's plots in a block averaged (id and plot hold averages such as 185.5 and 5.5). Maindonald, Braun and Andrews (2024) Section 7.2 and DAAG 3rd ed. Subsection 10.1.3 fit lmer(harvwt ~ 1 + (1 | site), data=ant111b); antigua, the plot-level table, carries the registry row.
Trees, one row each, with dbh and wood, bark, root and branch biomass; species and fac26 classify the trees, and the page fits no model (rainforest is its subset).
The US cars of MASS's Cars93 ('U.S. data extracted from Cars93'), with gpm100 and RoughRange derived from its columns; the help fits lm(gpm100 ~ Type + Price).
30 Cape fur seals, one row each, with organ weights; the help fits lm(log(heart) ~ log(weight)).
wide: one row per Canadian city, its population estimates for 1992 to 1996 as the columns POP1992 to POP1996; REGION is a five-level classification.

wide: one row per category of cotton worker, its numbers in the 1886 Board of Trade census and the 1889 US Bureau of Labor survey as the columns census1886 and survey1889, with the survey's average wage.
wide: one row per man of the CPS comparison group of the labor training evaluation, his real earnings in 1974, 1975 and 1978 as re74, re75 and re78; no other unit repeats and the page fits no model.
A subset of cps1 'designed to be better matched to the experimental data than cps1' (help page).
A subset of cps1 'designed to be better matched to the experimental data than cps1' (help page).
British first-class cricketers, one row each (birth year, lifespan, handedness, cause of death); the help fits coxph(Surv(life, kia) ~ bs(year,3) + left).
One row per host species with summaries (means, sds, counts) of cuckoo and host eggs from the tables of Latter (1902); the help notes they do not match cuckoos precisely.
Cuckoo eggs, one row each, laid in the nests of six host species; species is a six-level classification the examples compare, id an egg id, and no nest column.
Administrative regions, one row each, dengue recorded or not; the help fits glm(NoYes ~ humid, family = binomial); Xmin to Ymax are coordinates only.
Combinations of monthly maximum and minimum temperature with their average dewpoint, pooled over sites and months that have no column; the help fits lm(dewpt ~ bs(maxtemp,5) + bs(mintemp,5)).
One ice core's carbon dioxide record by age (EPICA Dome C, 0 to 800 kyr BP), a composite series.
Nine stretches of an elastic band and the distances it travelled; the help fits lm(distance ~ stretch).
Seven stretches of an elastic band and the distances it travelled; the help fits lm(distance ~ stretch).
The subset of possum 'that has measurements for the 43 females' (help page); possum carries the trapping sites.

Sites, one presence or absence of the corroboree frog each; the help fits glm(pres.abs ~ log(distance) + log(NoOfPools) + meanmin + meanmax, family = binomial); northing and easting are coordinates only.
Kiwifruit slabs, one row each (juice content, resistance); the help fits lm(ohms ~ bs(juice,4)).

One line of geophones, thickness by distance along it, a single spatial series; Maindonald, Braun and Andrews (2024) Chapter 4 fit gam(thickness ~ s(distance)) and examine its residuals' autocorrelation.
Annual apparent alcohol consumption (Beer, Wine, Spirit) for two countries; Country is a two-level design factor, so the table holds two short series, and the help only plots them.
The help: 'The data were simulated according to a simple logistic regression model to match roughly the clinical characteristics of a sample of individuals who suffered minor head injuries.'
Scottish hill races of 1984, one row each (also MASS's hills, time in minutes); the help fits lm(log(time) ~ log(dist) + log(climb)).
'The hills2000 dataset is the subset of races2000 for which type is hill' (help page).
One row per volcano of the Hawaiian chain (ID, name) with its K-Ar age and distance from Kilauea; the help fits lm(age ~ distance).
Ten seamounts, one Ar-Ar age each with its uncertainties and distance; no model.
Houses sold in Aranda, Canberra, in 1999, one row each; the help fits lm(sale.price ~ area).

Four athletes (id 1 to 4) with oxygen uptake at several power levels; with four levels and no mixed model on the page (the help fits lm(o2 ~ id + wattsPerKg:id)) id is a design factor. humanpower1, its five-athlete twin, carries the book's random coefficients model.
Named hurricanes that made US landfall 1950-2012, one row each; the help plots log(deaths+0.5) against log(NDAM2014), no grouping.
wide: one row per slag sample, its iron content by the chemical and the magnetic method as the two columns; the help fits lm(chemical ~ magnetic).
wide: one row per month of 1995-96, the seasonally adjusted labour force counts of six regions as the columns BC to Atlantic; the regions are exhaustive, so the long form holds six series.

Leaf measurements at six locations worldwide, with no tree or species column; location is a six-level classification of the sites, and the help fits lda and glm(arch ~ logwid + loglen, family = binomial) on leafshape17.
'The leafshape17 data frame is the subset that has data for North Queensland sites' of leafshape (help page).

The rows of leaftemp.all with CO2level, vapPress and the two temperature differences only, rounded and without day; in the first rows its tempDiff and BtempDiff are leaftemp.all's BtempDiff and tempDiff. Its help fits lm(tempDiff ~ CO2level + vapPress) among four lines; leaftemp.all carries the registry row.
20 mice, two per litter size, one row each; no litter id, lsize a covariate; the help fits lm(brainwt ~ lsize + bodywt).
33 families, one row each (family size, average weekly medical expenses per member).
'The dataset mifem is the subset that has data for females' of monica (help page).
A model car released three times at each of four starting points; the releases have no column and starting.point is a covariate; the help fits lm(distance.traveled ~ starting.point).
Patients of the Newcastle centre of the WHO Monica project, one row each with mortality outcome and risk factors; the help fits rpart(outcome ~ .).

One row per transect, counts of moths A and P with its habitat; Maindonald, Braun and Andrews (2024) Section 7.7 'Observation level random effects' sets moths$transect <- 1:41 ('Each row is from a different transect') and fits glmer(A ~ habitat + sqrt(meters) + (1 | transect), family = poisson(link = sqrt)), and DAAG 3rd ed. Section 10.5 fits glmer(A ~ habitat + log(meters) + (1 | transect), family = poisson) without Bank: an observation-level effect only, no column.
wide: one row per Northern Ireland mountain race, its male and female record times as time and timef; the help fits lm(log(time) ~ log(dist) + log(climb)).

Obtained from nsw74psid1 by here <- age <= 40 & re74<=5000 & re75 <= 5000 & re78 < 30000 (help page).
